modos.descricao: Causar 1 de dano + efeito baseado no estado do alvo

_metadata.texto_original: Requires: not frenzied. If Submission Hold damages a non-frenzied creature, that creature is removed from combat at the end of this round. If Submission Hold damages a frenzied creature, that creature cannot dodge next round.
notas: Alvo nao-frenzied: retirada do combate via _retirar_do_combate()
Alvo frenzied: restricao 'nao_pode_esquivar' adicionada a criatura
